newsitem.title: UK: Northwest Europe oil, gas rigs up one at 65 in wee.
newsitem.headline: Northwest Europe oil, gas rigs up one at 65 in wee.

text.p: The number of active oil and gas rigs operating in offshore Northwest European (NWE) waters rose to 65 in the week to March 5, up from 64 the previous week, consultants Arthur Andersen said.
The number of active rigs in U.K. waters was unchanged at 34 while rigs in Norwegian waters rose one to 20. Danish and Dutch drilling were both stable at three and eight rigs, respectively.
The report said that the total number of exploration wells spudded in NWE to date this year is exactly equal to the number for the same period in 1996.
